title: P2 seat.assign: request
description: Body of P2 seat.assign. An operator operation, only through farmctl, with admin:governance in the tenant of the seat, for the farm manager seat in farm (PRM-14). An existing functionary identity of this tenant in the state active takes a commission seat (parameter bot); for the farm manager seat the core always creates a new identity in farm, so it has no bot parameter (IDN-10, MGR-1). The core takes the tenant from the credentials.

seat.description: Seat id: farm-manager (the farm manager seat, tenant farm) or commission:<seat number from the tenant charter>.

bot.description: Functionary identity for a commission seat.
